properties.title: 3420 Cheviot Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45211
properties.description:
Welcome to 3420 Cheviot Ave, a classic 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom standalone single-family residence situated in a quiet, established Cincinnati neighborhood. Delivering 1,244 square feet of comfortable living space, this home features a thoughtful interior layout that effortlessly connects the welcoming central living room with bright dining and culinary spaces.

The kitchen is equipped with durable countertops, ample cabinet storage, and a full itemized appliance inventory including refrigerator, electric range and oven, dishwasher, and microwave.

Each of the 3 bedrooms offers generous dimensions and dedicated wardrobe closets. The primary bedroom suite provides a serene retreat with a private en-suite bathroom, modern fixtures, and vanity storage. Secondary bedrooms share convenient access to pristine hallway bathroom facilities.

Year-round comfort is assured with efficient central heating and air conditioning, accompanied by dedicated interior laundry hookups. Outside, enjoy a level private backyard and convenient attached garage and private driveway parking.

Pet-friendly living welcomes your companion animals. A standard $50 application fee applies per adult applicant. Submit your rental application today at Choice Properties.
